questions.expl: Because introduces a complete reason clause: her supervisor is unavailable. During and despite require a noun phrase instead.

questions.stem: The maintenance crew ___ the air-conditioning system before the store opened.
questions.expl: The inspection happened before the past event of the store opening, so the past perfect had inspected is appropriate.

questions.stem: Customers who register online will receive a ___ confirmation email.
questions.expl: An adjective is needed before the noun phrase confirmation email. Detailed describes the information in the message.

questions.stem: The board approved the proposal ___ several members had raised concerns.
questions.expl: Although connects two contrasting clauses. The board approved the proposal even though some members had concerns.

questions.stem: All invoices must be checked ___ payment is authorized.
questions.expl: Before introduces the later event, authorization. The invoices must be checked first.

questions.stem: The company is seeking an applicant with experience ___ international clients.
questions.expl: Experience is followed naturally by a gerund when describing an activity. Serving international clients is the required experience.

questions.stem: The manager asked the receptionist to reserve a room for ___.
questions.expl: The preposition for needs an object pronoun. Us is the object form of we; our and ours are possessive forms.

questions.stem: The warranty covers repairs that result ___ manufacturing defects.
questions.expl: Result from means be caused by. Manufacturing defects are the cause of the repairs covered by the warranty.

questions.stem: The marketing report provides a ___ comparison of the two campaigns.
questions.expl: The blank modifies the noun comparison, so an adjective is required. Useful describes the comparison.

questions.stem: If the parts arrive today, the technician ___ the machine tomorrow.
questions.expl: This is a first conditional: present simple after if and will plus the base verb in the result clause.

questions.stem: The conference organizers sent the schedule to all ___ participants.
questions.expl: Registered is a past participle used as an adjective meaning participants who have completed registration.

questions.stem: The office will remain closed ___ the electrical work is completed.
questions.expl: Until marks the endpoint of the closure. The office remains closed up to the time the work is completed.

questions.stem: The director spoke ___ about the need to protect customer data.
questions.expl: An adverb is needed to modify spoke. Seriously describes the director's manner of speaking.

questions.stem: The delivery driver could not enter the building ___ he had a valid access code.
questions.expl: Although introduces a contrast between having a valid code and being unable to enter. Because of would need a noun phrase.

questions.stem: Please keep a copy of the receipt ___ you need to request a refund.
questions.expl: In case introduces a possible future situation for which the receipt may be needed.

questions.stem: The warehouse has enough space to store the equipment ___ the renovation.
questions.expl: During is a preposition followed by a noun phrase. It identifies the period when the equipment will be stored.

questions.stem: The training manual is available in both printed and digital ___.
questions.expl: The phrase lists two types of the manual, so the plural noun formats is required.

questions.stem: The hotel offers guests a ___ breakfast before the early flight.
questions.expl: Complimentary means provided free of charge, which fits the hotel breakfast. Compliment is a different noun meaning praise.

questions.stem: The sales representative will contact you as soon as she ___ the updated figures.
questions.expl: In a future time clause after as soon as, use the present simple receives rather than will receive.

questions.stem: The audit revealed that the records had been stored ___.
questions.expl: The adverb improperly modifies had been stored and means not in the correct way.

questions.stem: The supplier offered a discount ___ we placed a larger order.
questions.expl: Provided that introduces the condition for receiving the discount. The other choices do not express a condition here.

questions.stem: The employee handbook explains how staff should respond ___ emergencies.
questions.expl: Respond to is the fixed collocation. Emergencies are what staff must respond to.

questions.stem: The project was completed on time, ___ the limited budget.
questions.expl: Despite is followed by a noun phrase and expresses contrast: the project succeeded even with a limited budget.

questions.stem: The company plans to expand its customer support team ___ next year.
questions.expl: The blank modifies the verb expand, so the adverb significantly is needed.

questions.stem: Applicants should attach a résumé ___ their application form.
questions.expl: The verb attach takes the preposition to before the item receiving the attachment: attach a résumé to the form.

questions.stem: The procurement officer requested three ___ from different suppliers.
questions.expl: Three requires a plural countable noun. Quotations are written offers stating a price.

questions.stem: The receptionist will notify visitors when their host ___.
questions.expl: Host is singular, so the present simple form is arrives. A future time clause uses present simple rather than will.

questions.stem: The company reduced shipping costs by negotiating a more favorable ___.
questions.expl: The article a and adjective favorable require a singular noun. Contract names the agreement being negotiated.

questions.stem: Please ensure that the package is labeled ___.
questions.expl: The adverb correctly modifies is labeled and describes how the package should be labeled.

questions.stem: The new policy applies to all employees, ___ their job title.
questions.expl: Regardless of is followed by a noun phrase and means that the policy applies without considering job title.

questions.stem: The flight was delayed ___ heavy fog at the airport.
questions.expl: Because of introduces a noun phrase that gives the reason for the delay.

questions.stem: The design team is expected ___ the first draft by Monday.
questions.expl: The passive expression be expected is followed by an infinitive: to finish the draft.

questions.stem: The director asked whether the figures were ___ enough to publish.
questions.expl: The linking verb were requires an adjective. Reliable describes figures that can be trusted.

questions.stem: The café will close early today ___ a private event.
questions.expl: For introduces the reason for closing early. It is followed by the noun phrase a private event.

questions.stem: The software update includes several security ___ for mobile users.
questions.expl: Several requires a plural noun. Improvements names the security changes included in the update.

questions.stem: The courier delivered the documents ___ than the client had expected.
questions.expl: Than requires the comparative adverb earlier. The delivery happened before the client's expectation.

questions.stem: The committee will meet to discuss ___ the proposal should be revised.
questions.expl: Whether introduces an indirect yes-or-no question after discuss. The committee will consider if revision is needed.

questions.stem: Our representatives are available to answer questions ___ the product demonstration.
questions.expl: After is followed by the noun phrase the product demonstration and identifies when representatives are available.

questions.stem: The office manager reminded staff ___ the new visitor procedure.
questions.expl: Remind someone of something is the fixed construction. The staff were reminded of the procedure.

questions.stem: The hotel requires guests to provide a credit card ___ check-in.
questions.expl: At is used with a specific event or point in time: at check-in.

questions.stem: The report was praised for its ___ analysis of customer behavior.
questions.expl: An adjective is required before analysis. Thorough means complete and careful.

questions.stem: The sales figures have increased steadily ___ the new campaign began.
questions.expl: Since introduces the starting point of a continuing change: the campaign began.

questions.stem: The company hired a consultant to improve its online ___.
questions.expl: Online presence is the standard noun phrase for how visible an organization is online.

questions.stem: The technician found the instructions too ___ to follow.
questions.expl: Confusing describes something that causes confusion. The instructions cause the difficulty, so confusing is correct.

questions.stem: The museum's opening hours may change ___ public holidays.
questions.expl: On is used with days and named occasions. Public holidays are the occasions when the hours may change.

questions.stem: Please keep the doors closed so that the air-conditioning system can operate ___.
questions.expl: An adverb modifies operate. Efficiently explains how the air-conditioning system can operate.

questions.stem: The supplier will replace any items that arrive ___.
questions.expl: Damaged is a past participle adjective describing items that arrive in a damaged condition.

questions.stem: The manager approved the request, ___ it exceeded the original budget.
questions.expl: Even though introduces a complete contrasting clause. The request was approved despite exceeding the budget.

questions.stem: The conference room is reserved ___ the afternoon session.
questions.expl: The room is reserved for the session, so for introduces the intended use.

questions.stem: The brochure gives a ___ description of the tour itinerary.
questions.expl: A noun is modified by an adjective. Brief describes the short description in the brochure.

questions.stem: The manager will review the schedule and make ___ changes if necessary.
questions.expl: Any is used before the plural count noun changes in this conditional sentence.

questions.stem: The restaurant has expanded its menu to include more vegetarian ___.
questions.expl: More modifies a plural count noun here. Vegetarian options are choices for customers who do not eat meat.

questions.stem: The employee handbook should be read carefully before it is ___ to new staff.
questions.expl: The handbook receives the action, so the passive form is distributed after is.

questions.stem: The airline apologized ___ the cancellation and offered a refund.
questions.expl: Apologize for is the fixed phrase used before the problem being apologized for.

questions.stem: The new filing system makes documents much easier ___.
questions.expl: The pattern is make something easier to do. To locate completes the adjective phrase easier to locate.

questions.stem: The manager asked for a more ___ explanation of the price increase.
questions.expl: More modifies the adjective specific, which describes the requested explanation.

questions.stem: The shipment cannot be released until the customs forms ___.
questions.expl: The forms receive the action, so are completed is passive. A time clause after until uses present simple.

questions.stem: The human resources department will conduct a ___ survey next month.
questions.expl: An adjective is needed before survey. Confidential describes information kept private.

questions.stem: New employees must complete the safety course ___ their first week.
questions.expl: Within introduces a period containing the deadline: during the first week.

questions.stem: The operations team is responsible for ___ daily inventory levels.
questions.expl: Responsible for is followed by a gerund. Monitoring describes the team's regular duty.

questions.stem: The candidate's references were contacted to verify her professional ___.
questions.expl: Professional modifies the noun experience, which means the candidate's work background.

questions.stem: The factory will stop production ___ the inspection is complete.
questions.expl: Until marks the point when production can resume. The inspection is a complete clause after it.

questions.stem: The supervisor gave the team clear instructions, and everyone followed ___ carefully.
questions.expl: Followed needs an object pronoun. Them refers back to the instructions.

questions.stem: The updated schedule is ___ on the company intranet.
questions.expl: The linking verb is requires an adjective. Available means the schedule can be accessed.

questions.stem: The factory installed new lights to improve visibility and reduce energy ___.
questions.expl: Energy consumption is the noun phrase for the amount of energy used.

questions.stem: The supervisor will approve the overtime request once the project manager ___.
questions.expl: Project manager is singular, and a future time clause after once uses present simple agrees.

questions.stem: The company is looking for a candidate who can work ___ under pressure.
questions.expl: Effectively is an adverb modifying work and describes performance under pressure.

questions.stem: The equipment must be handled with ___ to avoid damage.
questions.expl: With care is the noun phrase meaning carefully. The preposition with is followed by the noun care.

questions.stem: The manager was pleased ___ the team's progress during the trial period.
questions.expl: Pleased with is the fixed expression for being satisfied with something.

questions.stem: The new employee handbook contains useful information about workplace ___.
questions.expl: Workplace conduct is the noun phrase for behavior at work. The other forms do not fit after workplace.

questions.stem: The manager requested that all visitors ___ their badges at the entrance.
questions.expl: After requested that in a formal requirement, use the base form wear for the subjunctive.

questions.stem: The new packaging is designed to be both attractive and ___.

questions.stem: The company will offer a bonus to employees who ___ the training by June.

questions.stem: The repair should take no ___ than two hours.

questions.stem: The company has made a significant ___ in reducing paper waste.

questions.stem: The loading area is accessible only ___ authorized personnel.

questions.stem: The company postponed the launch ___ a shortage of components.

questions.stem: The assistant prepared the meeting room ___ and checked the projector.

questions.stem: The employee was promoted because of her ___ performance.

questions.stem: The instructions are written clearly enough for users to follow them ___.
questions.expl: Independently is an adverb modifying follow and means without assistance.

questions.stem: The company will not issue a refund unless the product ___ within thirty days.

questions.stem: The training coordinator sent a reminder to everyone who had not ___ yet.
questions.expl: Had not is followed by a past participle. Registered means the people had not completed registration.

questions.stem: The warehouse uses a barcode system in order to process orders more ___.
questions.expl: Rapidly is an adverb modifying process. It explains that orders are handled at greater speed.

questions.stem: The committee agreed to meet again ___ the proposal needs further discussion.

questions.stem: The company provides employees ___ protective equipment at no charge.

questions.stem: The new system is expected to make data entry less ___.
questions.expl: Less modifies an adjective. Time-consuming describes a task that takes a lot of time.

questions.stem: The supervisor praised the workers for completing the task ___.

questions.stem: The report must be signed by a manager before it can be sent ___.

questions.stem: She is a very [generous] person who always helps others.

questions.stem: She felt very [confident] before the interview.
